name: code_review
description: Shape-level code check (deterministic regex, zero LLM): naming, comment coverage, long functions, duplicated blocks, diff review (SEARCH/REPLACE). Clears shallow noise before deep review — not a correctness verdict.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: absolute path of the project root to review code in

file.description: File path relative to workspace_dir to review (reads from disk)

source.description: Source code text to review (mutually exclusive with file; source wins if both passed)

diff.description: Patch to review block-by-block: SEARCH/REPLACE (<<<<<<< SEARCH ... ======= ... >>>>>>> REPLACE) or unified diff (--- a/x.js / +++ b/x.js / @@ hunks). Pass one of file/source/diff; diff wins over source/file
